'''Cod''' is a common ⭐☆☆☆ [[fish]] caught by [[fishing]] in cold and cool [[Fishing#Cold saltwater|saltwater]]. It is vanilla {{MCW|Raw Cod|raw cod}}, renamed. It cooks into [[Cooked Fish|cooked fish]], and a [[Fisherman]] buys 12 caught cod for an [[Obol]].

== Obtaining ==
=== Fishing ===
The Cod can be caught in these climate tables.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/minecraft/loot_table/gameplay/fishing/saltwater_cold.json}}</ref> <ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/minecraft/loot_table/gameplay/fishing/saltwater_cool.json}}</ref> The chances are per cast of a [[Fishing Rod|fishing rod]] and include the junk and treasure rolls.
{| class="wikitable"
! Climate !! Biomes !! Weight !! Per catch (open water) !! Per catch (other water) !! Per catch ({{MCW|Luck of the Sea}} III)
|-
| [[Fishing#Cold saltwater|Cold saltwater]] || Frozen Ocean, Deep Frozen Ocean || 15 of 42 || 30.36% || 31.95% || 30.19%
|-
| [[Fishing#Cool saltwater|Cool saltwater]] || Cold Ocean, Deep Cold Ocean || 15 of 42 || 30.36% || 31.95% || 30.19%
|}

The same tables are also rolled by the fisherman's house chest in [[Village|villages]] and by the {{MCW|Elder Guardian|elder guardian}}'s drops, using the biome at the chest or where the elder guardian dies.

{{Sources}}

=== Mob loot ===
{{MCW|Guardian|Guardians}} drop cod, and {{MCW|Cat|cats}} can bring cod as a morning gift. These cod have no rarity line, so the Fisherman won't buy them.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/minecraft/loot_table/entities/guardian.json}}</ref><ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/minecraft/loot_table/gameplay/cat_morning_gift.json}}</ref>

== Usage ==
=== Food ===
Raw fish can be eaten, but it heals nothing: Matcha Flavoured removes [[hunger]], and food only heals through the hearts shown on its tooltip. Cooked, it becomes [[Cooked Fish|cooked fish]], which heals {{Hp|4}}.

=== Cooking ===
{{Cooking|station=Oven|Input=Cod|Output=Cooked Fish|note=5 s, 0.35 XP}} {{Cooking|station=Kindling|Input=Cod|Output=Cooked Fish|note=5 s, 0.35 XP}} {{Cooking|station=Mud Kiln|Input=Cod|Output=Charred Fish|note=5 s, 0.35 XP}}

The recipes match any <code>minecraft:cod</code>, so every small fish gives the same result.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/recipe/food/oven/cooked_cod.json}}</ref> A [[Mud Kiln]] burns it into [[Charred Fish|charred fish]] instead.

=== Trading ===
The [[Fisherman]] buys 12 caught Cod for 1 [[Obol]] once he reaches Apprentice level. Only fish caught by fishing (with the ⭐☆☆☆ line) are accepted.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/villager_trade/fisherman/2/cod.json}}</ref>

{{Uses}}

== Angler's Almanac ==
The [[Angler's Almanac]] has an entry for the Cod under Cold Saltwater (listed chance 35.7%) and Cool Saltwater (listed chance 35.7%), unlocked by catching one while the almanac tab is open.<ref>{{Source|MF_resourcepack/assets/minecraft/lang/en_us.json}}</ref> Its description reads:
<blockquote>''A cold-water classic that has been feeding people for centuries and still hasn't asked for a raise.''</blockquote>

== Advancements ==
* '''No More Fish in the Sea''' – catch every fish, including this one. Rewards 10 [[Obol]]s.
* '''Fishmonger''' – sell caught fish to a Fisherman.
